answer: The zephyr holds work receipts rather than names, so the relic of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the prism of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, expired if not renewed by fresh work, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
